title: wrightia pubescens subsp. laniti
intro: Wrightia pubescens subsp. laniti, commonly known as the "Indian snuff box" or "lanii wrightia", is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wrightia pubescens subsp. laniti include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including wrightin, wrightinin, and wrightininone, are responsible for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat a range of health issues.
